recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Future changes should be handled in SDC or by a new work-group decision about canonical display usage, not by adding QuestionnaireResponse.title or strengthening current core requirements.
issue_request: FHIR-14062 requested a QuestionnaireResponse.title element corresponding to Questionnaire.title so clients listing responses could identify the answered questionnaire without fetching it. The Published / Persuasive with Modification resolution chose the canonical display extension on QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire instead, with SDC-specific profile guidance.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to SVN #14772, represented by git commit b8c5990ac5ad735ba1e8e836fd8a4c6fd3534a3e. That commit did not add QuestionnaireResponse.title; it added display-extension guidance to Questionnaire.url, the canonical target used by QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire, as part of a broader Questionnaire/QuestionnaireResponse batch.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is active in source/fhir.ini, QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire is a required canonical Questionnaire reference, Questionnaire.url and the canonical primitive datatype document the display extension for human-readable canonical target names, and an active QuestionnaireResponse example shows the display extension under questionnaire. Later FHIR-32897 documented canonical display generally, FHIR-37550 clarified non-resolving/legacy QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire cases, FHIR-21468 made the SDC questionnaire display optional mustSupport, and FHIR-44989 declined a standard display-extension search parameter because the display cannot be assumed present.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was made because adding QuestionnaireResponse.title would contradict the final resolution, and adding new core prose that always requires or recommends title/display population would conflict with later SDC and search guidance.

related_jiras.note: Later core reconciliation documented display for canonical references generally and is already represented on the combined branch.
Made QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire required and added the current legacy/no-value-with-extension comment.
Changed SDC QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire.display from 1..1 to 0..1 mustSupport, so an unconditional core requirement would be inappropriate.
Declined a standard search parameter over the display extension because display cannot be assumed present and canonical-based search is preferred.
